{{inline |date=May 2024}}
In mathematics, a '''Szegő polynomial''' is one of a family of [[orthogonal polynomials]] for the Hermitian inner product

:<math>\langle f|g\rangle = \int_{-\pi}^{\pi}f(e^{i\theta})\overline{g(e^{i\theta})}\,d\mu</math>

where d&mu; is a given positive measure on [&minus;&pi;, &pi;]. Writing <math>\phi_n(z)</math> for the polynomials, they obey a recurrence relation

:<math>\phi_{n+1}(z)=z\phi_n(z) + \rho_{n+1}\phi_n^*(z)</math>

where <math>\rho_{n+1}</math> is a parameter, called the ''reflection coefficient'' or the ''Szegő parameter''.
